en: Black‑and‑white postcard photograph of a large cargo or tanker ship named "SUROIT" moored in a harbor or industrial port. The ship dominates the left and center of the image, with cranes and port infrastructure visible in the hazy background on the right. Calm water in the foreground reflects the hull and masts. On the lower left margin is a vertical credit line indicating the photographer and city.
